changes.title: Wisconsin Democratic governor primary too close to call between Crowley, Hong
changes.summary: Votes are still being counted in the Wisconsin Democratic primary for governor, with Rep. Francesca Hong and Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley separated by only a few hundred votes. NBC News’ Steve Kornacki looks at the numbers as well as races in South Carolina, Minnesota, and Connecticut.

changes.title: In Wisconsin, David Crowley defeats Francesca Hong in Democratic primary for governor
changes.summary: David Crowley is the Milwaukee County Executive and could become the state's first Black governor. He narrowly defeated Francesca Hong, a democratic socialist who drew enthusiastic support. (Image credit: Kayla Wolf).

changes.title: Crowley Beats Hong in Wisconsin Gubernatorial Democratic Primary
changes.summary: Democratic Wisconsin gubernatorial candidate David Crowley greets supporters at a campaign rally in Milwaukee on August 10, 2026. —Scott Olson—Getty Images Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley has won the Democratic primary race for Wisconsin’s governorship, toppling his Democratic socialist opponent, Francesca Hon.
